query:
WITH updated AS (
            UPDATE email_messages
            SET
                replying_to_id = $1,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE
                id = $2
                AND link_id = $3
                AND replying_to_id IS DISTINCT FROM $1
        )
        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM email_messages WHERE id = $2 AND link_id = $3
        ) AS "found!"
